queue_storage: Every host variant enforces the 16-byte non-pulse or 20-byte pulse item budget; existing 16-request saturation assertions remain; original non-pulse binary fails the named runtime assertion 3/3. Actual ARM symbols establish production saving.
preserved_assertions: Relocated fixtures retain their prior assertions; no snapshot auto-accept or unique assertion removal.

execution.quick: All behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported.
execution.full: Same scenarios plus relevant optimization, ABI, role, kernel and supported-core checks.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.

gaps: GPIO API failure/recovery is controlled; physical LED fail-off and real driver recovery are NOT RUN. PWM output is NOT APPLICABLE: this owner requires gpio-leds.
Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.

native_profiles.matrix: Repeat all seven declared native variants under each profile, one binary per configuration and three runs per binary; exact invalid-parent compiler guards in the default base variant only
native_profiles.strict_sanitizers: CONFIG_ASAN_RECOVER=n, -fno-sanitize-recover=all and halt-on-error runtime settings; inspect effective config and complete compiler flags
native_profiles.admission: Exit0 plus all required markers and no sanitizer diagnostics on stdout/stderr; pulse requires the debounced-sleep marker

gpio_driver_recovery.contract: Only call a ready LED device and record successful channel changes; later same-target requests retry failed channels, including sleep-off

debounced_sleep.contract: Sleep retires pending and claimed reservations; sleeping changes do not schedule, and new post-wake work honors its debounce and emits once.

timeout_width.contract: Full uint32 milliseconds, exact ceiling and configured kernel tick ABI; independent wide oracle and identified math/width controls

status_sleep_and_connectivity.contract: Every role/mode retires old output at sleep; deferred callbacks retain their generation and honor a new debounce exactly once; hidden USB indication follows the actual BLE profile state.
